text: {"defects": ["The shopping cart icon in the top right header displays a count of '0' despite there being 4 items in the cart.", "The 'Grand Total' label and amount ('US$199.50') in the Cart Total section have extremely low contrast (light grey text on an off-white background), making them faint and hard to read."]}

defects: The shopping cart icon in the top right header displays a count of '0' despite there being 4 items in the cart.
The 'Grand Total' label and amount ('US$199.50') in the Cart Total section have extremely low contrast (light grey text on an off-white background), making them faint and hard to read.
